extensionDescription.message: Archives an open email and selected attachments locally as one searchable PDF file.

attachmentsSliceTwoNote.message: Supported attachments are selected by default and merged in the displayed order. Clear a checkbox to skip a file.

attachmentIncludedDefault.message: Supported – selected for the merged PDF

attachmentUnsupported.message: Unsupported – this file will be skipped

attachmentLibreOfficeRequired.message: Skipped – install LibreOffice to convert this Office file

inlineImageExcluded.message: Inline image – not treated as a separate attachment

directoryNotConfigured.message: Set a local output folder in the settings first.

singleMessageRequired.message: Open or select exactly one email.

genericLoadError.message: The email could not be prepared for archiving.

archiveErrorSummary.message: The operation failed. The email was not modified.

archiveSuccessSummary.message: Saved $1 searchable page(s): $2 attachment(s) included, $3 skipped.

progressTransferring.message: Transferring email to the local companion …

settingsIntroduction.message: Saves readable email content and selected supported attachments as one local PDF.

languageHint.message: This choice applies to all PDF Archiver windows, menus, and messages.

outputDirectoryHint.message: The folder must already exist. The extension never overwrites an existing file.

folderPickerTitle.message: Select the folder for archived PDFs

imageModeHint.message: Embedding fetches external HTTPS images once. This can reveal your IP address to the sender. Unavailable or unsafe images are shown as placeholders.

separatorPagesLabel.message: Insert a separator page before each attachment

separatorPagesHint.message: Off by default. PDF outlines are added whether or not separator pages are enabled.

diagnosticsHint.message: The report contains readiness states only. It omits email data, filenames, URLs, and local paths.

connectionSuccess.message: The local companion and output folder are ready.

errorHostDisconnected.message: The local companion disconnected unexpectedly. Restart Thunderbird and try again.

errorNativeHostUnavailable.message: The local companion is not registered correctly or could not be started. Run the current installer again, then restart Thunderbird.

errorHostTimeout.message: The local companion did not respond in time.

errorIncompatibleHost.message: The extension and local companion have different versions. Run the current installer again.

releaseScopeDescription.message: Version 1.0.1 repairs the per-user macOS Native Messaging registration so Thunderbird can start the local companion.
